# Anaagat Humanpower

> Anaagat Humanpower is a workforce services company in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, and the parent company of the recruitment brand RecruitKr. It runs payroll, statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, CLRA), staffing, manpower services and workforce deployment for businesses and training centres, with one team covering hiring, deployment, pay and compliance. Motto: "Worshiping Work".

Key facts:
- Serves industries including manufacturing, warehousing and logistics, facility management, retail and e-commerce, construction, hospitality, healthcare, and corporate and IT.
- Works with training centres and institutes in two ways: payroll and compliance for their own staff, and hiring drives and career seminars on their campus.
- Permanent, bulk and campus recruitment and executive search are offered through RecruitKr (https://www.recruitkr.com).
- Founder and Director: Sachin Kumar.
- Contact: +91 90019 65072 (phone and WhatsApp). Office: 7/357, Sector 7, Malviya Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302017. Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 6:30 pm.
- Anaagat never asks job seekers for money to get a job.
